text:
jordan (secops): Heads up - seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures between eu-ingest and us-proxy since the RBAC keystore role change ~08:15Z. Errors are KMS UnwrapDenied at the proxy side. :rotating_light:

maria (infra): cc @jordan any chance the rotator lost permissions to read the intermediary keystore?

jordan (secops): That's my suspicion. Quick log excerpt from us-proxy: 
```
2026-03-18T08:16:02Z proxy[pid=422]: tls: handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-18T08:16:03Z proxy[pid=422]: kms: unwrap failed: AccessDenied: user is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
```

alex (eng-sre): Confirmed on some hosts. Rotator pod in eu-west never got the new iam-binding after the RBAC deploy. It fell back to cached certs for a bit, but caches expired and proxies started failing.

nina (platform): How wide is the hit? Is it just proxy->ingest or other east-west calls too?
jordan (secops): Mostly proxy->ingest and proxy->authtoken-service across regions. Rate is low but persistent. Observability shows elevated 502/524.

audit-bot: WARNING: 2026-03-18T08:14:50Z - keystore.role.update by deploy-bot removed 'keystore-reader:rotator' from service-account rotator-sa (no corresponding audit-backfill).

maria (infra): Oof. That explains it. The IAM delta was intentional for a tight-scope RBAC test but we missed adding the rotator binding. Rolling back now.

oncall: Quick mitigation: re-add role, restart rotator pods in eu-west, and temporarily widen KMS policy to allow decrypt from rotator-sa until we verify. Also enable fallback for proxies to accept cached certs for +30s.

jordan (secops): Agreed. Also worried about audit gaps — audit-bot says the update didn't create a change request entry, so we don't have a correlative trail for compliance. We should backfill.

alex (eng-sre): Commands I'm running: 
```bash
# re-add binding
gs iam roles add-iam-policy-binding "projects/redwood/keystores/rotator" --member=serviceAccount:rotator-sa@redwood.iam --role=roles/keystore.reader
# restart rotator k8s deployment
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator-eu-west
```

maria (infra): Doing that now. Will also open a support ticket with KMS if we see continued UnwrapDenied after rollback.

oncall: For immediate prod stability: add a temporary route rule to route eu traffic to us-proxy fallback pool in the same region until certs are healthy.

jordan (secops): Also flagging a vuln-triage item: if RBAC change could be applied without proper audit trail, that's a control weakness. I'll create a vuln ticket and include mitigation: require policy changes to run through infra-cd with enforced approvers.

nina (platform): Post-incident action items I propose: 1) add CI gate that checks keystore dependent services for ACL coverage before RBAC changes, 2) enable alerting on KMS UnwrapDenied spikes, 3) add a small cert-grace window on proxies, 4) backfill audit logs and attach to the deploy change.

jordan (secops): +1. Also add a runbook step to validate rotator SA bindings after any keystore policy change.

maria (infra): Rollback applied, rotator restarted. I see streaming reconnects and errors dropping. Will monitor for 15 mins then escalate if not stable.

audit-bot: INFO: 2026-03-18T08:25:03Z - audit-log-backfill task created by jordan (secops) for keystore.role.update 1763201220

oncall: Monitoring shows 502s down to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Please file postmortem and assign owners for the action items.

jordan (secops): Filing the postmortem now and assigning owners. Short-term fix in prod, long-term controls in backlog. Thanks for fast responses. :thumbsup:
